source: OS relationship model (UK Geospatial Entity Relationships), via github.com/chrisjmee/os-api-data-downloader

keys.name: OSID
keys.what: The primary identifier of every OS NGD feature: a 36-character GUID. It stays with the feature while the feature is updated and is retired if the feature is removed. Older OS MasterMap products used the TOID for the same job.

keys.name: UPRN
keys.what: Up to 12 digits, one for every addressable thing - houses, flats, shops, schools, but also things without a postal address, planned properties and ones since demolished. A UPRN never changes and is never reused.

keys.name: USRN
keys.what: Up to 8 digits, one for every street, including private roads, footpaths and alleys. Street works, maintenance and traffic orders are all recorded against it.

keys.name: Postcode
keys.what: A delivery grouping of around 15 addresses on average. Postcodes are created, split and retired, so they are a grouping to report by, not a property key.

keys.name: UDPRN
keys.what: An 8-digit number for each Royal Mail delivery point. One UPRN can have several UDPRNs, but not the other way round.

keys.name: GSS code
keys.what: A 9-character code for every statistical and administrative area - countries, councils, wards, parishes, health areas. A new code is issued when a boundary changes.

keys.name: UARN
keys.what: The Valuation Office Agency's reference for each property it values for council tax or business rates.

keys.name: ATCO code
keys.what: The identifier of each public transport access point in NaPTAN - bus stops, stations, ferry terminals.

keys.name: Water body ID
keys.full: Water Framework Directive water body identifier
keys.what: The identifier of each river basin district or water body catchment used in water management.

keys.name: Grid square
keys.what: The reference of a 1 km, 100 m or 25 m square of the National Grid.

keys.name: Feature ID
keys.what: The identifier of an aggregated retail area.

keys.name: Other identifiers
keys.full: Island, Northern Ireland and partner identifiers
keys.what: Street and property identifiers used in the Channel Islands, Isle of Man and Northern Ireland, and composite keys agreed with partners such as the Canal and River Trust.

features.title: 1 km Grid
features.about: The 1 km squares of the British National Grid.

features.title: 100 m Grid
features.about: The 100 m squares of the British National Grid.

features.title: Building
features.about: A whole building: the building parts that make up one structure, with its use, age, height, floors, roof and the UPRNs of the addresses inside it.

features.title: Building Access Location
features.about: The entrances to a building - where people get in.

features.title: Building Part
features.about: Each separately constructed part of a building, as drawn on the map, with its height and land use.

features.title: Built Address
features.about: Every current address that physically exists - homes, businesses, schools, flats - with its UPRN, position, classification and links to its street, postcode and areas.

features.title: Built Up Area
features.about: Built-up areas - the extent of towns and villages - as defined for statistics.

features.title: Bus Lane
features.about: Bus lanes, with the road link they are on and when they apply.

features.title: Canal Bridges
features.about: The Canal and River Trust's record of bridges over its waterways.

features.title: Channel Islands Street Identifier
features.about: The street identifier used in the Channel Islands' gazetteers.

features.title: Channel Islands Unique Identifier
features.about: The property identifier used by the Channel Islands' own address gazetteers.

features.title: Compound Structure
features.about: Structures made of several parts, such as bridges, piers and dams, treated as one.

features.title: Connecting Link
features.about: The short links that join the path network to the road network.

features.title: Connecting Node
features.about: Points on road links where the path network connects.

features.title: Council Tax
features.about: The Valuation Office Agency's council tax record for each home, keyed by UARN.

features.title: Country
features.about: England, Scotland and Wales.

features.title: Crowd Sourced Name Point
features.about: Local and informal names suggested by the public and matched by OS to the feature, address or street they describe.

features.title: Cycle Lane
features.about: Cycle lanes, with the road link they are on.

features.title: Devolved Parliament Constituency
features.about: Constituencies for the Scottish Parliament and the Senedd.

features.title: Devolved Parliament Electoral Region
features.about: The regions that elect additional members to the Scottish Parliament and the Senedd.

features.title: Digital Traffic Regulation Orders
features.about: Traffic regulation orders (speed limits, parking, restrictions) published in digital form.

features.title: Electoral Division
features.about: The areas that elect county councillors.

features.title: Ferry Link
features.about: Ferry routes between terminals.

features.title: Ferry Node
features.about: The ends of ferry routes.

features.title: Ferry Terminal
features.about: Ferry terminals, linked to the road and path networks and to NaPTAN.

features.title: Field Boundary
features.about: The hedges, walls and fences that divide fields.

features.title: GLA Assembly Constituency
features.about: The constituencies that elect London Assembly members.

features.title: Highway Dedication
features.about: Whether a road is a public highway, and for whom (all vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists…).

features.title: Historic Address
features.about: Addresses that no longer exist - demolished, merged or otherwise retired - kept with their UPRN for history.

features.title: Indicative Atlas of Radon (GB)
features.about: The British Geological Survey and UK Health Security Agency map of radon potential.

features.title: Inter Tidal Line
features.about: The lines of mean high and low water.

features.title: Isle of Man Street Identifier
features.about: The street identifier used in the Isle of Man's gazetteer.

features.title: Land
features.about: Every piece of land that isn't a building, road or water - grass, woodland, gardens, paved areas - with what it is and the site it lies in.

features.title: Land Point
features.about: Small land features shown as points, such as individual trees or springs.

features.title: Landform
features.about: The shape of the land: cliffs, slopes, embankments, cuttings.

features.title: Landform Point
features.about: Landform features shown as points, such as spot heights.

features.title: Local Authority Districts
features.about: ONS's local authority district boundaries and codes, used for official statistics.

features.title: Lower Tier Local Authority
features.about: District, borough, city and unitary councils - the lower tier of local government.

features.title: Maintenance Area
features.about: Who maintains a street, as an area - for example maintained at public expense.

features.title: Maintenance Line
features.about: Who maintains a street, as a line.

features.title: Maintenance Point
features.about: Who maintains a street, as a point.

features.title: NHS Health Authority
features.about: NHS health areas (such as Integrated Care Boards) that a postcode falls in.

features.title: NHS Regional Health Authority
features.about: NHS regions that a postcode falls in.

features.title: NaPTAN
features.about: The national list of public transport access points - bus stops, stations, ferry terminals.

features.title: Named Area
features.about: Named places shown as areas: woods, estates, bays.

features.title: Named Point
features.about: Named places shown as points: towns, villages, hills, landmarks.

features.title: Named Road Junction
features.about: Named road junctions, such as motorway junctions and roundabouts.

features.title: National Polygon Dataset
features.about: HM Land Registry's index polygons showing the extent of registered titles.

features.title: National Postcode Directory
features.about: ONS's directory linking every postcode to the statistical and administrative areas it falls in.

features.title: National Postcode Lookup
features.about: ONS's best-fit lookup from postcodes to statistical areas.

features.title: National Public Transport Access Nodes (NaPTAN)
features.about: NaPTAN stops, joined to the street they're on.

features.title: Non Addressable Object
features.about: Things with a UPRN but no postal address: bus shelters, telephone boxes, car parks, electricity substations, monuments.

features.title: Non Domestic Rates
features.about: The Valuation Office Agency's business rates (rateable value) record for each non-domestic property, keyed by UARN.

features.title: Northern Ireland Street Identifier
features.about: The street identifier used in Northern Ireland's gazetteer.

features.title: Output Area (Dec 2021, BFE)
features.about: ONS's 2021 Census Output Areas - the smallest areas census statistics are published for (around 125 households). Full-resolution boundaries.

features.title: Parish or Community
features.about: Civil parishes in England and communities in Wales - the most local tier of government.

features.title: Path
features.about: A named path made up of path links, such as a long-distance trail.

features.title: Path Link
features.about: A stretch of footpath, cycle path or track between two nodes - the building block of the path network.

features.title: Path Node
features.about: Where path links meet or end.

features.title: Pavement Link
features.about: Pavements alongside road links.

features.title: Polling District
features.about: The areas each polling station serves at elections.

features.title: Postcode Unit Area
features.about: The area covered by each postcode, drawn from the addresses in it.

features.title: Postcode Unit Point
features.about: A single point for each postcode, with the codes of the areas it falls in.

features.title: Prebuild Address
features.about: Addresses for properties that are planned or under construction, before they are built.

features.title: Rail
features.about: The surface area of railway land and track, as drawn on the map.

features.title: Railway Link
features.about: A stretch of railway between two nodes - the building block of the rail network.

features.title: Railway Link Set
features.about: A named railway line made up of railway links.

features.title: Railway Node
features.about: Where railway links meet or end, including stations.

features.title: Region
features.about: The English regions (formerly government office regions).

features.title: Regional Authority
features.about: Combined and regional authorities, such as the Greater London Authority.

features.title: Reinstatement Area
features.about: The reinstatement standard for street works (how a road must be reinstated after digging), as an area.

features.title: Reinstatement Line
features.about: The reinstatement standard for street works, as a line.

features.title: Reinstatement Point
features.about: The reinstatement standard for street works, as a point.

features.title: Restriction
features.about: Legal and physical restrictions on roads: one way, no turn, height, width and weight limits.

features.title: Retail Area Aggregated
features.about: Retail areas grouped into a single town or city retail centre.

features.title: Retail Area Major
features.about: Larger retail areas - town centres, high streets and shopping centres.

features.title: Retail Area Minor
features.about: Small clusters of shops and retail addresses.

features.title: River Basin District
features.about: The river basin districts used to manage water across Great Britain.

features.title: River Basin District Catchment
features.about: Catchments grouped into river basin districts.

features.title: Road
features.about: A named or numbered road made up of many road links, such as the A6.

features.title: Road Junction
features.about: A junction made up of several road nodes, such as a large roundabout.

features.title: Road Link
features.about: A stretch of road between two junctions or ends - the building block of the road network, with its name, class, width, speed and direction.

features.title: Road Node
features.about: Where road links meet or end - junctions and dead ends.

features.title: Road Track or Path
features.about: The surface area of roads, tracks and paths, as drawn on the map.

features.title: Routing Hazard
features.about: Hazards for routing such as fords and level crossings.

features.title: Routing Structure
features.about: Structures that affect routing: bridges, tunnels, barriers, gates.

features.title: Royal Mail Address
features.about: Royal Mail's postal address (from the Postcode Address File) for each delivery point, keyed by UDPRN.

features.title: Site
features.about: A site with one purpose - a school, hospital, farm, industrial estate, park - with its land use and the buildings, land and addresses that belong to it.

features.title: Site Access Location
features.about: The entrances to a site and the road or path node each one joins - where you actually get in.

features.title: Site Routing Point
features.about: An earlier way of giving a site's routing point; replaced by Site Access Location.

features.title: Special Designation Area
features.about: Special designations on streets - traffic sensitive, protected, special engineering difficulty - as an area.

features.title: Special Designation Line
features.about: Special designations on streets, as a line.

features.title: Special Designation Point
features.about: Special designations on streets, as a point.

features.title: Street
features.about: A street as recorded in the National Street Gazetteer, with its USRN, name and the authority responsible for it.

features.title: Street Address
features.about: The street-level address record: street name, locality and town for each USRN.

features.title: Street Light
features.about: Street lighting along road links.

features.title: Structure
features.about: Built structures that aren't buildings: bridges, walls, towers, pylons, tanks.

features.title: Structure Line
features.about: Linear structures: walls, fences, hedges, retaining walls.

features.title: Structure Point
features.about: Small structures shown as points: posts, masts, monuments.

features.title: Title Number and UPRN Look Up
features.about: HM Land Registry's lookup from title numbers to the UPRNs of the properties they cover.

features.title: Tram On Road
features.about: Where trams run on roads shared with traffic.

features.title: Upper Tier Local Authority
features.about: County councils and unitary authorities - the upper tier of local government.

features.title: Ward
features.about: The areas that elect district, borough and unitary councillors.

features.title: Water
features.about: The surface area of water: rivers, lakes, reservoirs, the sea, with the site it lies in.

features.title: Water Body Catchment
features.about: Catchments of the water bodies used in water management.

features.title: Water Catchment
features.about: The land area that drains to a stretch of watercourse.

features.title: Water Link
features.about: A stretch of watercourse between two nodes - the building block of the water network.

features.title: Water Link Set
features.about: A named watercourse made up of water links, such as a river.

features.title: Water Node
features.about: Where watercourses meet, start or end.

features.title: Water Point
features.about: Small water features shown as points, such as springs and wells.
